cancellation_semantics: Check non-nil context during document preflight and freezing, before and after every provider call and source hash, throughout CPU raster, between atomic opacity/dissolve/composite stages and before publication. Any failure returns a zero Result and no partial Surface.
capability_semantics: This additive v2 Compile preserves every v1 native/vector capability and may additionally advertise only cutly.text.pinned-font-viewport-px.v2 when StaticTextV2 is enabled. Enabled Text is restricted to static frozen fill plus transform, crop and opacity; text.fill lanes, non-zero Text transitions, legacy Text and rendering extensions fail closed.
clip_semantics: Apply evaluator crop and transform through cutly.raster.cpu-affine-bilinear-linear-rgba16.v1 to native, intrinsic vector or intrinsic Text surfaces, then evaluator opacity. TextFill must exist and equal the frozen asset's static fill exactly; it is evidence only and is never reapplied after text rasterization.
composition_semantics: Process evaluator layers strictly in background-to-foreground track-array order and source-over each completed target layer. Native/vector/Text interleaving, provider completion order and map iteration cannot change z-order.
dispatch_semantics: Freeze the canonical Document v2 asset, timeline, track, clip and transition indexes. Video/image dispatch only to native, viewport-vector only to expression, and pinned static Text v2 only to the text-layer provider. No provider chooses scope, time or z-order.
excluded_responsibilities: Dynamic text paint, rich text, fallback/system fonts, bidi inference, Text transitions, media decode trust, audio, masks, output color conversion, encoding, muxing, persistence, scheduling, signatures and publication remain outside this compositor.
failure_semantics: Unsupported capability, wrong provider route, scope/index/kind/profile/hash/time/geometry/receipt mismatch, unavailable required provider, overflow, cancellation or kernel failure fails closed. There is no provider fallback, lower-quality vector path, partial source set or success with a missing layer.
gap_semantics: A timeline time with no active supported visual layer returns one complete transparent target Surface and an explicit empty source array.
ownership_semantics: Compile deep-freezes canonical document-derived dispatch state. Programs support arbitrary seek order and concurrent immutable reads. Provider surfaces are borrowed only for validation/rasterization, target surfaces own their pixels, capabilities are defensive copies and serializable receipts contain no mutable provider storage.
receipt_semantics: V2 preserves the v1 ordered evaluation union and adds an optional Text branch containing the exact textlayer FrameReceipt. Text is visible-clip-only; every scope/time/profile/identity agrees with the frozen Program. Serialized receipts remain structural claims, while live validation recomputes final pixels.
resource_semantics: Bound document graph/canonical bytes and tracks before compile; bound active layers/source requests, every provider surface, target/raster dimensions, exact geometry bits and the fixed six-target-frame working peak. Full target layers are processed incrementally; receipts scale only to MaxSourceRequests.
source_validation: Apply all v1 validation and, for Text, require the complete textlayer request echo, frozen binding/semantic/layout/font identities, provider-authenticated assembly and raster receipts, exact viewport/static paint lineage and an independently recomputed immutable surface hash.
transition_semantics: Native and vector dissolve semantics remain v1. Any non-zero transition involving a Text track is rejected at compile and a Text transition reaching runtime fails as an invariant; zero-width records remain inert hard cuts.
